Package alice.tucson.api

Interface Summary
TucsonContext Interface of any TuCSoN agent coordination context An agent coordination context defines (and enables) the actions that an agent can do on by means of a coordination medium.
 

Class Summary
Agent Defines the skeleton for simple TuCSoN agent base class
AgentId Defines the identifier of an agent interacting with the TuCSoN infrastructure
AgentIdOperatorManager This class defines the operator manager used for parsing agent identifiers.
Automaton This class defines a state-based TuCSoN Agent.
ContextDescription This class represents an Agent Coordination Context Description
DefaultContextDescription This class represents a default Agent Coordination Context Description
Tucson Tucson Meta Agent Coordiation Context, which can be used to get an agent coordination context to access TuCSoN services
TupleCentreId Defines the Tuple Centre identifier for TuCSoN logic tuple centres.
TupleCentreIdOperatorManager This class defines the operator manager used for parsing tuple centre identifiers.
 

Exception Summary
ContextNotAvailableException This exception is thrown when a context that is not available is requested
InvalidAgentIdException This exception is thrown when an invalid agent identifier is used Agent identifier must be ground logic term
InvalidContextDescriptionException This exception is thrown when an invalid context description is used
InvalidSpecificationException This exception is thrown when an invalid ReSpecT specification is used
InvalidTupleCentreIdException This exception is thrown when an invalid tuple centre identifier is used Tuple centre identifier must be ground logic term
OperationNotAllowedException This exception indicates that an operation requested is not allowed by the agent coordination context
TucsonException Generic TuCSoN Exception
UnreachableNodeException This exception is thrown when an unreachable TuCSoN node has been specified in an operation
